reasons.auth: The documentation explicitly states that authentication is via HTTP Bearer token in the Authorization header, using keys formatted as ipx_live_xxxxx or ipx_test_xxxxx.
reasons.access: Users can sign up and obtain API keys from the dashboard. A free tier is available with rate limits (10 audits/day), and the homepage mentions starting free with five lifetime audits, indicating self-serve access without mandatory payment for initial credentials.
reasons.mcp: The vendor publishes official documentation for an MCP server at /docs/mcp-server and hosts a public GitHub repository for the @ipayx/mcp-fx-audit package, confirming an official MCP server.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation exists, self-serve free credentials are available, and an official MCP server is provided, allowing a toolkit to be built immediately.
